|printed_title=<span lang="ja">一体全体どうして、こんな羽目になるのかね</span>
|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">自分のドロイドが「大砂原」もしくは「アクセス・リンク」のある位置にいる時に使う。１フォース消費して、手札を全部ユーズドデッキに捨てる。同じ枚数のカードをリザーブデッキから引いて手札にする。ドロイドがＣ－３ＰＯかＲ２－Ｄ２ならば、引くカードの枚数に１枚足せる。</span>
|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">大砂原に不時着した後、Ｒ２－Ｄ２は人間の居住区のありそうな峡谷へ向かうと主張した。Ｃ－３ＰＯは、反対だった。</span>''
|translation=<blockquote>
'''Title:''' How Did We Get Into This Mess?

'''Card text:''' Use when your droid is at the ‘Great Desert’ or a location with an ‘access link.’ Spend 1 Force to discard your entire hand to the Used Pile. Draw the same number of cards from the Reserve Deck into your hand. If the droid is C-3PO or R2-D2, you may add one to the number of cards drawn.

'''Lore:''' After making an emergency landing in the great desert, R2-D2 insisted on heading toward a canyon that would contain human settlements. C-3PO disagreed.
</blockquote>

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses ‘Great Desert’ for the location called the Dune Sea in English and ‘access link’ where the English says Scomp link. The Japanese says one card may be added to the draw if the droid is C-3PO or R2-D2; the English says to draw one extra card.
